descriptionNullable: Same-formula isomer panels for evaluating forward-model (spectrum simulator) re-scorers in the Enveda CASMI 2026 competition. Built from the competition train.parquet (row indices `qidx` of query spectra) and our public candidate pool (casmi26-v2-pool): draws.parquet (draw_id, sid, key, smiles, formula, mass, qidx, adducts, modes, ces, precs) and cands.parquet (draw_id, pid, key, smiles, is_truth, fz_A, fz_AB). Panels: syn (random enveda-180-only timsTOF structures), np (enveda-np-examples timsTOF holdout), nplib (NP-library structures). No spectra are stored; they are read from the competition data inside Kaggle. Source: our project casmi26 (work/analysis/fwd/panel_build.py).
